summary: A Turkish freelance illustrator living in Lisbon with a rescue dog, a co-working desk, surf habits and a mix of Nordic and German clients; mostly English with Turkish and a few Portuguese words.

items.title: Work
items.text: The user is a freelance illustrator based in Lisbon; most of the income comes from children's picture books and concept art for indie games.

items.title: Co-working desk
items.text: The user rents a hot desk at Casa Pátio, a co-working space in Cais do Sodré, and goes there Monday to Thursday; Fridays are for working from home.

items.title: Dog Pastel
items.text: The user has a rescue dog named Pastel, a four-year-old mixed breed of about 14 kg who is afraid of thunder.

items.title: Pastel's vet
items.text: Pastel's vet is Dr. Marta Figueiredo at a small clinic in Alvalade.

items.title: Client Nordlys
items.text: Nordlys Forlag, a Copenhagen publisher, is the user's most regular client; the current job is a picture book series about a fox called Rufus, with art director Mette.

items.title: Client Pixelwolf
items.text: Pixelwolf Games in Berlin hires the user for character concept art at an hourly rate of €55; the producer there is Jonas.

items.title: Client Mercado Verde
items.text: The user designs packaging illustrations for Mercado Verde, a Lisbon café chain, on a fixed project fee; Rita Soares is the art director there.

items.title: Vergi düzeni
items.text: Kullanıcı Portekiz'de recibos verdes (serbest meslek makbuzu) kesiyor; vergi işlerini muhasebeci Sofia Matos üç ayda bir takip ediyor.

items.title: Para transferi
items.text: The user receives client payments in a Wise account and moves the money every Friday to a Millennium BCP conta à ordem to cover daily expenses.

items.title: Surfing habits
items.text: The user surfs a 6'4 fish and usually goes to Ericeira on Sundays when the swell is under two metres; the wetsuit is a 4/3 mm.

items.title: Annesi
items.text: Kullanıcının annesi Eskişehir'de yaşıyor ve her pazar akşamı görüntülü arıyor; doğum günü 28 Eylül.

items.title: Kardeşi Can
items.text: Kullanıcının kardeşi Can İstanbul'da yazılım mühendisi olarak çalışıyor; doğum günü 12 Nisan.

items.title: Partner Inês
items.text: The user's partner Inês is an architect in Lisbon; her birthday is on 19 June.

items.title: Daire ve kira
items.text: Kullanıcı Arroios'ta kiralık bir dairede oturuyor; kira ayda 1.050 euro ve her ayın 1'inde ev sahibi Bay Menezes'in hesabına yatıyor.

items.title: Portekizce kursu

items.title: Ceramics class

items.title: Çizim ekipmanı

items.title: Health plan

items.title: Coffee habit

items.title: Nordlys agreement - fees
items.text: Illustration Agreement with Nordlys Forlag, Clause 3 - Fees: The Publisher pays €380 for each completed full-page spread, which makes €4,560 for the twelve spreads of Book One. Invoices are payable within 30 days of receipt.

items.title: Nordlys agreement - revisions
items.text: Clause 5 - Revisions: Up to two rounds of revisions per spread are included in the fee. Further revisions are billed at €45 per hour. The Publisher must give written feedback within five working days of each delivery.

items.title: Nordlys agreement - rights
items.text: Clause 8 - Rights: The Illustrator retains copyright, and the Publisher receives an exclusive licence to print and distribute the books in Denmark, Norway and Sweden for five years. Original artwork remains the property of the Illustrator.

items.title: Nordlys agreement - termination
items.text: Clause 11 - Termination: Either party may terminate with 14 days' written notice. Work delivered up to that date is paid pro rata, and a kill fee of 20 percent of the remaining balance is due.

items.title: Casa Pátio terms - access
items.text: Casa Pátio Membership Terms: Hot desk members may use the space Monday to Saturday, 08:00 to 21:00. Fixed-desk members have 24/7 access with a key card. The monthly fee for a hot desk is charged on the first of each month.

items.title: Casa Pátio terms - meeting rooms
items.text: Meeting rooms can be booked up to 14 days in advance; members receive four free hours per month and extra hours cost €12. Cancellations less than 24 hours before the booking are charged in full.

items.title: Casa Pátio terms - guests and dogs
items.text: Guests are allowed with prior notice at reception, and each member may bring a guest up to three times a month. Dogs are permitted in the courtyard but not in the open-plan area.

items.title: Portekizce kursu - program
items.text: A2 Portekizce Kursu Haftalık Program: Dersler çarşamba akşamları 19:00-21:00 arasında Anjos'taki dil okulunda yapılır. Toplam 40 saatlik eğitim 10 hafta sürer.

items.title: Portekizce kursu - ücret
items.text: Ücret ve ödeme: Kurs bedeli 320 euro olup iki taksitte ödenir. İlk taksit kayıtta, ikincisi beşinci haftada alınır. Telafi dersi hakkı en fazla iki derstir.

items.title: Portekizce kursu - sınav
items.text: Sınav: Dönem sonunda yazılı, dinleme ve konuşma bölümlerinden oluşan 2,5 saatlik bir sınav yapılır. Başarılı olanlara A2 düzeyini gösteren okul sertifikası verilir.
